rows.title: Royalty / brand fee
rows.body: Ongoing 6% GRR + 1% F&B on prescribed revenue bases—upper-upscale lifestyle standards, QA, and IHG portfolio access.

rows.title: Marketing / brand fund
rows.body: 3% services contribution (GRR aggregate) covers marketing and reservations-related services in aggregate.

rows.title: Technology / systems
rows.body: $17.06/room/month technology services fee plus PMS (Opera), CRS, IHG Concerto, Wi‑Fi, and related mandatory stack.

rows.title: Loyalty / program participation
rows.body: IHG One Rewards: 4.55% full folio · 1.36% room/meeting. Model net contribution after member benefits and chargebacks.

rows.title: Reservation / distribution
rows.body: GDS about $6.40/reservation; IHG Ignite digital marketing about 2.25% on qualifying consumed revenue. Stress-test OTA vs direct mix.

rows.title: Training / opening support
rows.body: Application $100,000 min ($500/key); PIP inspection about $12,000; pre-opening support $20,000–35,000; department-head certification $40,000–60,000.

rows.title: To Join
rows.body: Application $100,000 min ($500/key); PIP inspection about $12,000; Pre-opening support $20,000–35,000; Department-head certification $40,000–60,000; PMS/CRS implementation often $97K–$130K for ~176–200 keys (premise-based illustrative); Design and F&B concept development fees vary by asset

rows.title: To Operate
rows.body: Steady-state 6% GRR + 1% F&B; 3% services contribution (GRR aggregate); Loyalty 4.55% full folio · 1.36% room/meeting; Technology $17.06/room/month; GDS $6.40/reservation; Capital reserve up to 5% of gross revenue may apply

rows.title: When Things Change
rows.body: Renewal PIP, conversion PIP, re-licensing fees, termination liquidated damages, and reserves—triggered at renewal, flag change, or exit.

Illustrative 200-room total investment $65.1M–$91.5M ($325,352–$457,585/key, excluding land). Amounts paid to IHG/affiliates before opening often $607,000–$1.1M in the same illustration.

Front-loaded standards, FF&E, F&B, and technology

Working capital through ramp (3-month initial phase often $1.5M+ hotel operating funds)

Fee stack stepping from opening-weighted to stabilized

Renewal PIP reserves even if opening PIP is lighter
